environment.mode: bundled Chromium, headless, unpacked Manifest V3 extension
environment.profile: new temporary profile; reused only for this synthetic restart test

checks.name: unpacked extension installs and starts its actual Manifest V3 worker
startup creates a separate inactive Usage tab without a user action
content script reads two visible cards and reset times through Chrome messaging
DOM text mutations update popup and real global/tab toolbar badge values
conflicting or removed cards invalidate previously fresh observations
popup rescan round trip completes without renewing unchanged timestamps
English/Chinese popup controls and refresh preference writes work
synthetic conversation text never becomes a quota observation
selected one-minute alarm automatically reloads background Usage and updates readings
active Usage tab is scanned without reloading
watchdog recreates a closed monitor via a real Chrome alarm
navigated monitor is never refreshed as a conversation and watchdog replaces it
pause cancels refresh and survives watchdog events and popup reopen
stale readings leave the headline and clear removes all observed rows
browser restart preserves interval/language/pause preferences and clears session readings
resume after restart creates a Usage tab and restores the selected interval
no extension or fixture JavaScript errors

network.policy: Local HTTPS fixture transport active before startup; CONNECT chatgpt.com:443 terminates only at a loopback fixture server; all other hosts/methods/paths denied; no upstream connections

limitations: Synthetic UI fixtures only; no signed-in account or live ChatGPT compatibility tested.
OS notification delivery and browser toolbar geometry are outside this harness; badge values are inspected through the real chrome.action API.
